Data products · Field-level lineage

Source-to-Target Lineage

Our team built a way to trace a field back to its source and see what could be affected if it changed.

evoke

The problem

An SSIS package shows how data moves through a workflow. It can reference a table or procedure without showing its current structure. People needed a way to check what they were seeing before making a change.

The decision

We combined information parsed from SSIS packages with current metadata from Snowflake and SQL Server. Code builds the graph from that evidence. AI interprets a person’s question and explains what the graph can show.

What we built

People can trace where a field came from, see the transformation that produced it and check which downstream fields may depend on it. The evidence also helps them see where the answer is uncertain.
